en.ui.weld.title: Weld
en.ui.weld.family.arc: Arc and fusion, along a line
en.ui.weld.keep_type: Changing the type keeps whatever still applies.
en.ui.weld.where.line: Pick faces, edges, sketch or 3D lines, or construction geometry. Two faces, or a drag across faces, find the joint.
en.ui.weld.where.groove: Pick the two parts. The groove is read from them and the parts never change.
en.ui.weld.where.point: Pick points on a sheet, or sketch points.
en.ui.weld.where.hole: Pick the hole or slot in the top sheet.
en.ui.weld.where.stud: Pick the hole or slot in the top sheet, and the stud’s foot edge. The stud is your own part.
en.ui.weld.where.ring: Pick the circular edge or the interface between the parts.
en.ui.weld.where.area: Pick the faces, or a region on them.
en.ui.weld.flip_hint: Flip side shows because a sheet body is picked. The inside of the angle is the default.
en.ui.weld.size.leg_hint: Leg z = 4.2. Remembers your last size.
en.ui.weld.size.hole: The diameter comes from the hole.
en.ui.weld.face.spot: Face: not used for spot welds
en.ui.weld.face.unused: Face: not used for this type
en.ui.weld.extent.spot: Extent: not used for spot welds
en.ui.weld.extent.plug: Extent and sides: not used for plug / slot welds
en.ui.weld.extent.stud: Extent and sides: not used for stud welds
en.ui.weld.extent.overlay: Extent and sides: not used for overlay / surfacing welds
en.ui.weld.extent.friction: Extent and sides: not used for friction welds
en.ui.weld.extent.projection: Extent and sides: not used for projection welds
en.ui.weld.extent.fusion_spot: Extent and sides: not used for fusion spot welds
en.ui.weld.extent.stake: Extent and sides: not used for stake welds
en.ui.weld.extent.ultrasonic: Extent and sides: not used for ultrasonic welds
en.ui.weld.extent.explosion: Extent and sides: not used for explosion welds
en.ui.weld.extent.diffusion: Extent and sides: not used for diffusion welds
en.ui.weld.extent.magnetic: Extent and sides: not used for magnetic pulse welds
en.ui.weld.extent.cold: Extent and sides: not used for cold pressure welds
en.ui.weld.corner_hint: Two beads wrap round; three or more meet in a point.
en.ui.weld.notice.tight: Tight spot at Edge 2: concave depth reduced to 1.2 mm.
en.ui.weld.notice.clash: Weld 2 clashes with Bracket. The bead is built anyway; the clash zone is red.
en.ui.weld.notice.fit: Leg 8 mm runs off Face 3. 6.2 mm fits.
en.ui.weld.notice.section: The groove changes along this joint. These stretches are constant:
en.ui.weld.notice.iso: Fails ISO 5817 at every quality level (B, C, D). “Tint this bead” is ticked.
en.ui.weld.notice.lost: Edge 2 is missing. The weld keeps its last shape and is still counted.
en.ui.weld.notice.depth: The groove is only 6 mm deep, so s = 8 is not shown.
en.ui.weld.notice.sheets: Point 3 has one sheet. A spot weld needs at least two.
en.ui.weld.new_bead_tip: Finish this weld and start the next one with the same settings; the tool stays open
en.ui.weld.no_mass_hint: Empty: no mass; the BOM shows “not set”.
